entries.subject: Types.luau::PlayerView.schemaVersion
entries.reason: Server-owned migration bookkeeping, projected deliberately so a support probe can read a live player's schema version without a DataStore round-trip. No client file reads it and none should. The hand-written reachability spec this gate replaced carried the same exemption, dated, for the same reason.

entries.subject: Types.luau::PlayerView.stats.joinCount
entries.reason: REAL DEBT, not a false positive. DataService increments it on every join (DataService.luau:154) and no client file displays it, so the server pays replication for a value nobody sees. Waived for one cycle to keep the gauntlet honest rather than red; the fix is to either surface it in the HUD or stop projecting it into PlayerView. The 30-day expiry forces that decision instead of burying it.

entries.subject: Types.luau::PlayerView.stats.playtimeSeconds
entries.reason: REAL DEBT, and the worse of the two: this field is never WRITTEN either. Migrations initialises it to 0 and no code anywhere increments it, so it is dangling on both ends — persisted, replicated, and dead. Waived for one cycle only; the fix is to accumulate it server-side or drop it from the view. Exactly the written-never-read pattern this gate exists to catch, caught on the gate's first run against a game that had just been through a 66-defect audit.
